lines: This quad of letters is neuter —
it bears both shades: ṛ ṝ ḷ ḹ.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tad etad varṇacatuṣṭayam ubhayacchāyādhāritvāt napuṃsakam ṛ ṝ ḷ ḹ iti

c1_essence: The r-quad is neuter because it carries both shades.
